t: You're standing by St Matthew's, an eighteenth-century Anglican church in Bethnal Green. It belongs to the Diocese of London. The church was designed by George Dance the Elder, a British architect. Dance served as the City of London's surveyor and architect from 1735 until his death in 1768, so he held the post of official architect to the City for more than three decades. That makes this a church by one of the leading architects of its day.
